name: netbench
description: NetBench — browser network lab for junior network and systems administrators

scripts.build: npm run build -w @netbench/engine && npm run build -w @netbench/api --if-present && npm run build -w @netbench/web --if-present
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,eve -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:eve"
